planets.name: WASP-96 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-96 with a 3.43-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: WASP-96 b was found in 2014 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-96. Its orbit and size follow Hellier et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname HELLIER_ET_AL__2014): disc_year 2014, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.4252565, pl_radj 1.2, pl_bmassj 0.48
